Customer Service · AI says:

Wild Earth offers an 80-day change-of-mind return window from the order date, including for sale items. Eligible items may be refunded to the original payment method or issued as store credit; online purchases can be returned by post or in store.

Items must be unused, as-new, with original tags and packaging intact. Original packaging must not be used as the outer shipping layer. Shoes may only be tried on indoors. Underwear (unless faulty; bras are exempt), harnesses, helmets, ropes, climbing gear, gas canisters, and special-order or custom items cannot be returned for change of mind.

Include your receipt or a note with your Tax Invoice number, contact details, and reason for return. Send returns to Wild Earth Returns, 27 Central Drive, Burleigh Heads, QLD 4220 Australia. Tracked or registered post is recommended, and return postage is your responsibility.

After inspection, returns are processed within 3 business days of arrival. Refunds go to the original payment method unless you choose store credit; they typically appear within 1–3 business days, depending on your bank or payment provider.

Proof of purchase is required. Price differences, promo codes, and discounts cannot be refunded or reapplied. Promotional gifts must also be returned, or their value may be deducted. Direct exchanges are unavailable: purchase the replacement separately, then return the original for a refund or store credit.

For assistance, contact support on 1800 847 841 or service@wildearth.com.au. I’m sorry for any inconvenience this process may cause.
